(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of __C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, and arylalkyl, wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is __C1-C12-alkyl excluding ethyl__, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is __methyl__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __excluding potassium__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (Il b) in which Z is sodium __and not potassium__.
